articleTitle: Concept of Creation of a Digital Twin in the Uniform Information Environment of Product Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Digital duplicate of the product in information space shows the work of physical object throughout its life cycle. The implementation of this technology will accelerate the development of new products, reduce the time for their testing and certification, and accelerate the start of production. This will increase the competitiveness of the national aviation industry products. The internal component of the digital twin is a structured multidimensional matrix of functional, technical, technological, operational and economic properties that are formed and manifested at individual stages of the life cycle of aircraft. The article discusses the concept of a single information environment, reveals the concept of a digital duplicate of the product, describes the approaches used in its creation, shows the benefits of using such technology to create modern aircraft models.

articleTitle: Modeling of Product Life Cycle Stages Optimization Taking into Consideration Uncertainty of the Main Parametrical Variables
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Modern trends in the development of military and civil aviation are aimed at the constant growth of cruising and limit flight speeds of promising aircraft. The largest aviation powers (Russia, the USA, the EU, China, Japan) have created supersonic passenger and military aircraft and are talking about creating hypersonic aircraft. The pace of development of industrial technologies requires a significant reduction in the development of aviation equipment, so the advanced military aircraft of the 5th generation (Su-57, F-22, J-20, F-35) were developed within 10-15 years, and the requirements to the terms of creation of advanced aircraft complexes currently is no more than 8 years. These facts require a significant optimization of the aircraft life cycle stages, in particular, a significant volume of the development stage. In this paper, we consider the process of multi-criteria optimization of aircraft parameters at the stage of development and initial coordination of the minimum aerodynamic drag head-end of the aircraft fuselage, and assess the impact of this optimization on the life cycle of the product.

articleTitle: About the Use of Artificial Intelligence Methods in Aviation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of the report is to trace some current and potential trends in the development of artificial intelligence technologies in the field of solving problems of civil and military aviation.

Author Keywords: decision support systems for aircraft crew

articleTitle: Users’ Activity in Online Social Networks and the Formation of Echo Chambers
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we develop an agent-based model to explore how agents' activity patterns affect echo chamber formation when their mutual interactions are controlled using a personalization system algorithm that decides what information users will be exposed to. In our model, agents can undertake two types of actions: publish a post and like a post. Our experiments revealed that the key parameter that guides agents' opinion dynamics is the probability of publishing a post: agents who often publish posts tend to enter echo chambers. In contrast, the roles of network topology and liking behavior are far less influential.

articleTitle: Identification of Integrated Rating Mechanisms as Optimization Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A problem of identification of an integrated ranking mechanism is considered. We present a perspective approach to the task of identification of an integrated ranking mechanism - we show that representation of any such mechanism in one-hot encoded form allows us to formulate such a task as an optimization problem that may be solved with a wide variety of optimization techniques. The approach suggested is illustrated by several examples of identification or approximation of learning sets generated by several Boolean functions.

Author Keywords: Modelling and decision making in complex systems

articleTitle: Towards the Issue of the Cybersecurity Analysis of a Significant Object of Critical Information Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The number of cybersecurity events in the world has grown significantly, and the most significant number of events falls on the objects of critical information infrastructure. The article considers the issues of risk formation and its assessment.

articleTitle: Multi-Valued Neural Networks and their Use in Decision Making on the Management of a Group of Unmanned Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: To make a management decision in the UAV group, a multi-valued associative memory is used. Such a memory is a new concept, generalizing the similar in fuzzy neural networks. In a multi-valued neural network, inputs are elements or subsets of the lattice of linguistic variables. The lattice is assumed to be distributive and defines the implication used to determine the output of a neural network.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Quality of Predictive Models of Macroeconomic Parameters of Moscow for the Period of 10 years
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In 2009-2010 the team of the Institute of Control Sciences carried out a set of works on analysis, modeling and forecasting the development of the pension system and the dynamics of the income replacement ratio in Moscow, the results of which were published in a number of articles on this subject. This paper compares the forecast values obtained 10 years ago with the current values of the estimated indicators. It is concluded that it is possible to use the proposed methods to simulate and predict socio-economic systems in the future.

articleTitle: Real Market Volatility Equilibrium Model Based On Spoiler Equilibrium Concept
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We regard two tightly interconnected problems. First of all we theoretically regard the origin of endogenous instability or volatility of economics system. Then we are trying to reduce this complex non-linear problem to a classical economic non-excludable resource access problem to recognize pure economic conclusions concerning reducing corresponding market failures.We introduce a common notion of a spoiler equilibrium as an equilibrium usually observed in a multy-agent game systems where rational agents compete for a sufficiently bounded resource that is not excludable. Exactly that a situation arises when somebody uses any public facilities (or common goods) starting from classic commons tragedy problem up to traffic jam problem.In that case there is no price but always there are some market clearing variables. We call this market clearing variables as spoiler factors.In the volatility equilibrium model we recognize the same type of resource distribution when instead of price mechanisms that are generally close to Pareto-efficient one faces resource attractiveness diminishing through the volatility, that decreases each argent's integral leverage demand, while the integral leverage happens to be bounded due to equilibrium stability constraints depending on eigenvalues.

articleTitle: The Development of Electromechanical Actuator Mathematical Model for Fault Identification Using Data Mining Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: General data analysis scheme is proposed for algorithms development for assessing the technical state of an electromechanical actuator (EMA) using data mining (DM) techniques. The EMA model is considered, which is proposed to be used to assess the technical state of EMA and form a base of study cases for the application of DM techniques.

articleTitle: Problems of Scenario Modeling of the Transport Complex
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes a calculation model for the development of the transport complex in the diversified structure of the Russian economy. The model is a set of variables describing the numerical characteristics of the subject area and a set of dependencies that relate the values of variables. The model is designed to solve functional problems of the long and medium-term, such as: determining the size and structure of demand for transportation by a specific mode of transport; assessment of the influence of factors of a general economic nature (dollar exchange rate, price level for the main types of products, etc.), the economic situation in related sectors of the economy (production volumes, product prices, etc.) on the performance indicators of individual types of transport ; and also, an assessment of the impact of the state of a particular type of transport on the performance of sectors and on the economy as a whole; determining the prospects for the development of each type of transport based on forecasts of changes in the economic situation in the country, the dynamics of the development of related sectors of the economy and competing modes of transport. The solution to these problems is based on an analysis of scenario options for the development of transport for the future and an assessment of the possible consequences of the adoption of certain decisions. The model was used to predict the transport situation and plan the activities for a large transport company. The scenario is given by the values of the exogenous variables of the model. An approach to creating a scenario-based modeling system for a transport complex supporting hierarchical structures for the formation of computational problems, examples of their solution for various development scenarios is presented.

articleTitle: Some Aspects of Creation of Flexible Modeling Software Package for NPP
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: An approach is considering, according to which the flexible modeling software package is the core of the digital twin of an NPP power unit, which can apply for a wide range of tasks from application in operator information support systems and diagnostic systems to assessing the cybersecurity of a nuclear power plant and developing cybersecurity measures.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Identification of Structural Shifts in Processes with a Unit Root
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report deals with the detection of structural shifts in the mode of obtaining current observations for processes described by time series with a unit root. We have identified various types of structural shifts and proposed methods for detecting and identifying them.

articleTitle: Rational Pricing of Fruit-Harvesting Robots
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A methodology for evaluating the economic efficiency of fruit harvesting robots and rational pricing for such robots, so that they would be in demand by horticulturists, is presented. It is shown that the main obstacle to the broad implementation of robotic technology for fruit crop harvesting is the overpricing of existing fruit-picking robot prototypes.

articleTitle: A Model of the Russia’s Agriculture Readiness for Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the problems of the effective implementation of digital technology in Russia's agriculture and how to solve the same by comprehensive and integrative methods. We present a mathematical model of Russia's agricultural readiness for digital transformation. We consider the results of calculating several development scenarios of the sector digitalization.

articleTitle: Integration of Hybrid Intelligence Components Based on the Quadrant Enabled Delphi Method While Diversifying XBML Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report proposes a new approach to integrating hybrid intelligence components in purpose to create a virtual semantic environment. The idea is mainly focused on providing monitoring of activity and selective interaction based on "Commonsense Knowledge." The basis for their applicability is the integration components of protocols through the "Blackboard System" for organizing multi-sided communication of eventual subjects with each other.

articleTitle: Mixed Investment Portfolio with Limited Asset Selection
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The work proposes a method for the formation and optimization of a mixed investment portfolio under the conditions of restrictions expressed in the obligation to launch a share of the real projects.

articleTitle: New Functions for Designing Supervisory Control Systems for NPPs
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: It proposes adding several functions based on the use of modern types of computer technology for the upper level of NPP APCS of new generations. A list of functions, their placement at NPPs, the personnel involved, implementation methods are providing. Issues of ergonomics and cybersecurity discussed.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Quasilinear Systems with Multiparameter Singular Perturbations
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a construction of a stabilizing controller in a weakly nonlinear singularly perturbed system, where the matrix coefficients depend on state variables. The system contains groups of slow, fast and ultrafast variables. The control is constructed by means of the SDRE approach and is based on non-linear corrections of linear composite one.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models and Algorithms for Forecasting National Security in Training Situational Centers
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A mathematical model is presented, developed based on a system dynamics model, for carrying out an express analysis of the state and forecasting the national security of states. An algorithm for using the developed mathematical support in assessing the state of national security of states is presented. The method of training specialists in the field of national security in training situational centers is shown.

articleTitle: Automatic Modular License Plate Recognition System Using Fast Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Confident and accurate license plate recognition is challenging due to the large number of noise factors. Such factors as: dirt on the plate, background of the plate, light, etc. To solve the problem under such conditions, a three-stage algorithm based on several convolutional neural networks is proposed. At the first stage, the plate is detected using a fast convolutional neural network SSD, in the second stage, the location of each character is quickly searched using the ResNet convolutional neural network, and in the third stage, each character is recognized using several ResNet convolutional neural networks. The experimental results on the sets show that the proposed approach surpasses the existing methods in terms of performance and recognition speed, while maintaining the same accuracy.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Building Regression Decision Tree Using Complementary Features
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In the so-called explained artificial intelligence, there is a need to build small models, but accurate and intuitive for the analyst. It is necessary to formalize, which models are perceived by analysts and decision-makers as intuitively understandable and plausible. It's shown that the use of accumulated information about additional to each other in some sense, complementary features can improve the accuracy of the small regression decision trees, as well as make them more plausible. The formal definition of the complementarities of the feathers is proposed. Algorithm of building regression decision tree with complementary features is presented. Condition of plausibility of two-levels decision tree is described.

articleTitle: Modeling of Price Consequences in the Competitive Electricity Market in Russia with the Intensive Development of Non-Carbon Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers approaches to modeling the relationship between electric power production structure and prices at a competitive electricity market for different scenarios of nuclear power and renewable energy development. The estimates of changes in spot prices obtained on the basis of a dual solution to the problem of optimal dispatching of the load of power plants are presented.

articleTitle: Estimation of Derivatives of Given Actions in UAV Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The procedure of dynamic feedback synthesis was developed, which provides tracking of a given trajectory by the center of mass of an unmanned aircraft. Under conditions of incomplete information on state variables and derivatives of the driving actions, invariance is ensured with a given accuracy with respect to external uncontrolled disturbances. The main result of the work is the synthesis procedure of the differentiator of the given actions, built on the basis of a virtual dynamic model with an unknown input.

Author Keywords: observers of the state and given actions

articleTitle: MES Systems as an Integral Part of Digital Production
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article considers issues of place and role of MES systems in digital production. The types of «factories of the future» and their main characteristics are demonstrated. The abilities of a digital platform for the car industry are revealed. The necessity of transforming business processes using integrated cyber-physical systems (CPS systems) is proved.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Software with a Variant NoSQL Data Schemes
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The popularity of web applications and platforms for collecting big data has set the goal of efficient data storage. NoSQL databases have become widely used for data storage and scaling. However, there are also a number of problems associated with the choice of efficient data storage and data schemes. The solution of these problems requires an understanding of the runtime conditions and possible loading of the system, which relies primarily on dedicated computing resources. The same data storage schemes can show different efficiency while under different critical load conditions or different computing infrastructures. In this paper, we propose a framework and experiment methodology for two NoSQL storage schemes that allow us to evaluate the most preferred option in the design of the developed application. The paper presents an analysis of the efficiency of two database schemas for maintaining a reliable saving of semi-structured data stream with specified characteristics.

articleTitle: Application of Integrated Mechanism in Financing Project Works
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The issues of building an integrated management mechanism by combining two different mechanisms are considered. One mechanism is designed to distribute finances for the performance of work, the second - to stimulate the performance of work on time. The parameters of mechanisms are determined that induce to inform the planned costs of the work as close as possible to the actual costs and reduce the actual time of the work. The conditions are analyzed, the execution of work with minimal cost and on time.

Author Keywords: reduction of time to complete work

articleTitle: A Study of Formalizations of User Influence in Actional Model
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We develop different approaches to formalize the concepts of influence and influence levels of users in online social networks based on the actional model of influence. Then we give examples of calculating the influence levels of users in an online social network and compare the conceptual formalizations of influence levels with each other.

articleTitle: Some Method of Complex Structures Information Security Risk Assessment in Conditions of Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed method for information security risk assessment of complex structures based on fuzzy logic methods, allows us to take into account such hard-to-define parameters as threat levels, vulnerabilities, potential damage, information resources control level, cost level.

articleTitle: Online Protest Mobilization: Building A Computational Model
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to contemporary developments in agent-based modeling of protest with regards to social media activity. We propose a mathematical model of user activity on Twitter, taking into account the ideology of users when sharing (retweeting) political messages and memes.

articleTitle: Parameters Synthesis of Technical Objects under Parametric Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: To synthesize the parameters of technical objects, we offer optimization models in which the objective functions and constraints depend on the input data and optimized parameters with epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. In these models, optimization criteria ensure the optimality on average and the reliability of solutions.

articleTitle: Features of Using Optimization Models for Capacity Expansion Planning in the Power Systems with the Increasing Role of Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Current trends in the development of optimization capacity expansion models for planning the development of power systems with the active growth of renewable energy sources (RES) are considered. The results of forecasting the conditions of inter-fuel competition in the Unified Power System (UPS) of Russia as well as a comprehensive assessment of energy and economic effects of various scales of RES development using the EPOS optimization model are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of Algorithms for Solving the Aircraft Landing Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report considers the developed simulation software tool for analyzing the efficiency and speed of algorithms for solving the aircraft landing problem.

articleTitle: Scenario Analysis of Development of Complex Logistics Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The current state and problems of development of complex logistics systems are considered. The main elements of the global logistics system that form cargo flows are highlighted. Promising models and methods have been proposed that allow for a through scenario analysis of the flows of international logistical transformations, in order to attract additional volumes of cargo to international transport corridors, including the East-West corridor, taking into account not only the throughput and processing capabilities of infrastructure and the presence of rolling stock, but also taking into account border, customs, sanitary, phytosanitary and other restrictions on functioning. Scenarios for the development of international logistics in the implementation of threats of various types are considered.

articleTitle: Technology for Developing a Digital Ecosystem Of Cultural Objects Data
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The relevance of the research topic is due to the need to digitize cultural heritage sites using digital technology for interdisciplinary research. The article analyzes and selects an object from the general List of objects of cultural heritage to be digitized. Studies of the selected cultural object were carried out, the geographical location of the object was determined, and geometric dimensions were determined. Analyzed modern scanners for digitization, identified the requirements for portable equipment. The requirements for creating a prototype of a digitized object are defined. For accuracy of research work on digitization, the Passport of the cultural object is defined, the passport contains a description of the metadata of the cultural object. From a historical point of view, the purpose of the cultural object in the Middle Ages is determined. The registration number of the cultural object in the registry is determined, there is a photo - Volumetric and spatial composition. The authors analyzed the technological approach to digitizing a cultural object with a scanner; the type of scanner and elements of portable equipment were selected. A review of domestic and foreign studies in the field of creation and creation of 3D prototypes of a necropolis of a geographically distant object is carried out. When conducting research, a system analysis was used. The directions of development of the Government of the Russian Federation and the legislative documents of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation are comprehensively considered. The first steps in the development of 3D prototypes in the virtual world of all existing cultural objects. Scientific and novelty wiring is the development of preparatory procedures for monitoring the state of a cultural object from space. The main goal of interdisciplinary research is to build a Digital ecosystem of these cultural heritage objects and to develop technological, information, communication approaches and software solutions to improve the quality of monitoring the state of the cultural object. Research is conducted on a competitive basis under a registered grant from the Russian science Foundation, international grant Russia-France, MNC-ANR (2020). Conducting fundamental scientific research and research by international research teams" (ANR).

Author Keywords: digitization of a cultural heritage object

articleTitle: Problems of Optimization of Control for Crossroads with Multi-Stage Passage of Traffic Flows
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The topic of the paper is the control problem at urban road intersections which characteristic feature is their separation into sections with local regulation by traffic lights; some passage directions for such intersections demand stops at internal stop lines. Methods for solution of constituent problems of structural and parametric optimization are presented; they are based on choice of traffic passage schemes at each section as well as the sequence and duration of traffic lights phases and aimed to the necessary safe traffic intensity achievement in all admitted directions.

articleTitle: Quadratic Approximation of Nonlinear Models of the Synchronous Machine Using the Bilinear Representation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The widespread use of new power electronic devices and the integration of renewable energy sources have increased the non-linearity and non-stationarity of modern electric power systems. Taking into account and modeling these nonlinear effects with sufficient accuracy requires the use of quadratic and higher order approximations of nonlinear power system models. However, sufficiently accurate bilinear models of synchronous machine are not easy to find in the literature. Therefore, in this paper we develop a quadratic approximation for the conventional sixth-order model of a synchronous machine using the Carleman bilinearization procedure. The developed bilinear model for one generator can further serve as a basic building block for constructing nonlinear approximations for general power system models.

articleTitle: The Aggregate Model of Business Valuation by Three Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: An express model that combines three main methods of assessing a company's value is considered. An analytical formula for the value is derived under the assumption that some specific parameters applicable for mature companies are constant. The problem of value optimization for some combinations of parameters is solved. Calculations were made for one of the largest Russian companies.

articleTitle: Dynamic Fragment Allocation in Distributed System with Time-Varying Parameters of its Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of dynamic fragment allocation in a distributed data processing system is considered in the article. The model of dynamic redistribution of table fragments is described. A heuristic algorithm for placing fragments depending on the current parameters of a distributed system is presented.

Author Keywords: fragments of tables of distributed databases
a heuristic algorithm for placing fragments of tables

articleTitle: Estimation of Posterior Class Probabilities in the Problem of Differential Diagnostics of Diseases of the Mucous Membranes of the Oral Cavity
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The approximation of the discriminant Anderson function at a point by a linear function in the feature space used in supervised learning allows us to estimate the posterior probabilities of classes at a point without using conditional probability distributions of feature classes and without using add-ons such as the Platt calibrator. We used the method of evaluating the posterior probability of a class to develop a computer program for differential diagnosis of oral lichen planus with oral leukoplakia and oral squamous cell carcinoma. Diagnosis by the posterior probabilities of diseases in the examined patient increases the reliability of the diagnosis and greatly facilitates the choice of treatment tactics.

Author Keywords: evaluating of the posterior probability of a class
squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity

articleTitle: Analysis of the Prognostic Ability of Methods for Forecasting Share Quotations Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the research of several effective models for forecasting the stock quotes dynamics. This study is based on an analysis of the predictive ability of five prediction methods with the use of a sample, including 30 companies from two market segments: automotive and information technology.

articleTitle: Assessing the Risk Potential: Selecting Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The digitalization of technological processes is carrying out within the Industry 4.0 concept, which involves the widespread use of mathematical modeling and predictive analytics methods. The paper considers different types of predictive models. The paper proposes using instant predictive models (for example, the model of the temperature of the feed water behind the HPH5) to assess the risk potential.

articleTitle: Acoustic Monitoring of the Psycho-Emotional State of Operational Personnel in the Management of High-Risk Objects Based on Neuromorphic Self-Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: High confidence in the definition of operational personnel psycho-emotional state is achieved by using a modern element base (processing environment) - a unified neuromorphic platform in the form of a fractal memristive structure with space-parametric self-learning. Experimental study of the proposed platform revealed its ability to synthesize new structural solutions and "dimensions" of the operational personnel psycho-emotional state information representation.

articleTitle: The Economic and Mathematical Model of Medical Organization Management
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: For solving problem of management of the large-scale system development the economic and mathematical model is made. This model maximizes the financial result from the rendering paid medical services and medical services financing from the obligatory medical insurance fund, decreases the cost prices and tariffs, materially and morally motivates the staff to effective job due to free joined to the polyclinic population growth and rendering services volume increase.

Author Keywords: material and moral stimulation of work

articleTitle: Computer System of Organization of Multilinear Optimization Calculations on Models of Balance Type
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Dynamic non-linear models of the balance type are classified. Working with models is based on a combination of simulation and optimization methods. Optimization allows both quasi-dynamic and dynamic modes of operation. For dynamic optimization, the problem of combating the accumulation of errors in calculations is very urgent.

articleTitle: On the Usage of Semantic Text-Similarity Metrics for Natural Language Processing in Russian
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This work is devoted to the analysis of the applicability of text processing methods in natural languages to the problem of assessing the similarity of text sequences of arbitrary length in Russian. This task is a particular problem that finds its application in many areas of computational linguistics, primarily in the analysis of the effectiveness of the computer-generated text. The analysis revealed the advantage of using the BERTScore method, based on the semantic similarity of text attachments, especially in terms of the reliability and sequence of detecting semantic similarity of sentences compared to traditional text metrics based on character-by-character analysis of texts.

articleTitle: Tools for Implementing the Financing Mechanism for the Waste Processing Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The economy of the Russian Federation at the present stage is characterized by an extremely high level of consumption of raw materials and waste generation. This is due to the export-raw material orientation of production, as well as the level of technological development. In this regard, the amount of waste generation and accumulation is steadily increasing.. Analysis of current trends has shown that every year, on average, Russians emit about 80 million tons of municipal waste. At the same time, both in Russia and in other countries, the structure of MSW is approximately the same. These are primarily glass, paper, plastics, fabrics and organic products, as well as oversized items such as old furniture, car parts, etc. At first glance, recycling household garbage is a fairly simple and profitable business. Thus, by recycling car tires, you can get rubber coatings that are actively used in the economy, new paper is made from waste paper, and organic garbage is obtained from. The work was carried out with the financial support of the RFFI grant on the topic "development of project financing mechanisms in the field of solid municipal waste management and proposals for their implementation", registration number 20-010-00302 A.

articleTitle: Towards Forecasting Ground Temperature Along a Pipeline Route
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed approach of forecasting ground temperature within geotechnical monitoring systems allows to complex geological, geophysical, geochemical and technological information and to make informed production decisions compensating the impact of linear extended objects on the bearing ground.

articleTitle: Ensemble Forecast Based on Neural and Statistical Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the methodology for forming an ensemble forecast based on statistical and nonlinear analysis methods. An example of forecasting financial time series based on an ensemble forecast is given.

articleTitle: Quadrocopter Vibration Damping
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The proposed work is devoted to the analysis of the operation of damping elements in a quadrocopter, shock-absorbing vibration of engines with pulling screws (as sources of vibration), and of a controller that is protected from vibration. For analysis, a 3-mass quadrocopter model and the method of electromechanical analogies are used. The purpose of the study is to determine the degree of suppression by the damping elements used the vibrations propagating from the working engines to the controller. The purpose is also to determine the parameters of the damping elements at which the maximum vibration suppression in the used construction of the real quadrocopter under consideration is ensured. The proposed approach to the analysis of the shock absorbers in specific mechanical systems allows you to clearly demonstrate how important it is to choose the damping elements’ parameters, especially in systems with several degrees of freedom.

articleTitle: Research Principles of Mathematical Theory of Socio-Technical Systems Control
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The general research principles of mathematical theory of socio-technical systems (STS) control are considered. These principles - rationality, coordination and decomposition reflect the specifics of STS as control objects with a complex structure (logical, cause-and-effect, process, etc.), requiring coordination of the life cycles of their elements and including subjects demonstrating active behavior.

articleTitle: Entropic Approach to Sustainable Development Issues
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Ensuring sustainable development is considered from the standpoint of entropy theory. Various directions of the struggle with the growth of entropy are proposed, the necessary conditions for sustainable development are formally determined. The technological, economic, environmental, and managerial aspects of counteracting the growth of entropy are analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: About the Structural Aspects of Investment
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In recent years, structural policy and the study of structural aspects of various economic processes, including investment, are relevant for modern macroeconomics. Experts point out that one of the complex problems of statistical research of structural changes and differences is the complexity of calculating quantitative characteristics and their qualitative interpretation.

articleTitle: Procedures of Railway Energy Conservation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Control procedures for energy conservation are considered in a two-level system, at the upper level of which there is a centre, and at the lower level - an enterprise. The centre does not know the possibilities of energy saving of the enterprise. The conditions for the synthesis of normalization and incentive procedures that provide adaptive identification of the energy saving possibility of an enterprise are found. The implementation of these procedures is illustrated by the example of energy saving in the JSC Russian Railways.

articleTitle: Towards the Foundations of Methodology for Assessing the Information Capabilities of Structural Identification Algorithms for Designing Automatic Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a new approach to study the various aspects of the practical application of structural identification algorithms. We analyze the risks arising by applying these algorithms at the pre-design stages of creating automatic control systems. In particular, we show that using these algorithms creates the possibility of an unforeseen deterioration in the estimation quality of a technical object's output variable. We formulate methodological recommendations for the practical application of structural identification algorithms. In particular, we are developing a flowchart for searching for an adequate mathematical model of a technical object based on the use of structural identification algorithms. We present a preliminary assessment of the information capabilities of structural identification algorithms.

Author Keywords: methods and algorithms for structural identification
search for an adequate mathematical model

articleTitle: Scheduling of Cycles of Volumes of Discharges of Enterprises – Natural Resource Users into the Water Basin
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a method for correcting the schedule of wastewater discharges of water users that provides the maximum permissible concentration of pollutants in the water basin, taking into account the actual needs of water users.

articleTitle: Data Normalization Models in the Security Event Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of data transformation in the security event management systems of robotic complexes and their negative influence on the development of correlation methods in such complexes are considered. The article offers the methodical support for building correlation rules and a modified model of the incident life cycle, taking into account the sources of events.

articleTitle: Organization and Management of a Multiple Functional Structure for Large-Scale Informational Processing Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A multiple functional structure consists of a large number of databases of the same type but contains different content. These databases are not connected in principle but are managed from a single center. The issues of managing such systems using a management database are considered. It offers the possibility of using service-browser technology for this purpose.

articleTitle: Special Features of Evaluating the Efficiency of Large-scale Infrastructure Network Projects
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes an unconventional model for assessing the public efficiency of a large-scale infrastructure project, which is inherent in the current stage of development of the Russian economy and is aimed at maximizing investor capital growth at the end of the billing period, taking into account the scenarios for the effective use (reinvestment) of capital generated from the profit received from the project, and lost profits.

articleTitle: Cybernetics Systems: Algorithmization in the Tasks of Primary Evaluation of Objects in a Complex Unmanned Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider an approach to substantiating the utility function to obtain initial estimates for the quality indicators of complex technical systems (CTS) in the form of a formalized information model taking into account the consistency of expert estimates. As an object of CTS research, there is a model for a truck with a trailer as part of multifunctional complexes with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV). A model and algorithmization of the process of forming an information-analytical system with the results obtained for selected indicators for assessing the technical level of a truck with a trailer are presented.

articleTitle: The Problem of Controlling a Steam Generator under Conditions of Uncertainty and Restrictions on Phase Variables and Controls
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of synthesis of robust control of a steam generator with regard to restrictions on phase variables and control under the influence of external uncontrolled disturbances. To solve this problem, the block method ideology is applied. Sat functions, that restrict phase variables and control, are used as local feedbacks.

articleTitle: Developing a Flight Mission Simulator in the Context of UAVs Group Control
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes the generalized process of creating a virtual simulator with an integrated geographic information system for modeling flight missions of unmanned aerial vehicles. The capabilities of the simulator allow forming flight missions for both single drones and their groups, and export data of completed missions to conduct real flights.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Stochastic Problems of Stock Investment
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a game with nature as a decision-making model in stochastic problems of stock investment. The mathematical expectation of the investor's gain is taken as an assessment of efficiency. The standard deviation is used as an assessment of risk. The emerging two-criterion problem is formalized using the method of translating one criterion into a constraint. The case of pure strategies (the choice of one investment option) and the case of mixed strategies (diversification of investment) are considered. For the case of mixed strategies, either the problem of maximizing a linear function with one linear and one quadratic constraint or the problem of minimizing a quadratic function with two linear constraints arises. Analytical solution methods based on the Karush - Kuhn - Tucker optimality conditions are obtained for both problems. Practical examples of the application of these methods using real statistical data are given.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of Disturbed Open-loop Control Obtained by the Covering Method
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this work, the influence of the parametric uncertainty on a control constructed by the covering method is numerically investigated. It is shown that for the given system, a change in the control law to closed-loop control is possible. The results of the numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control replacement method.

articleTitle: An Example of Verification of the Initial Data for Designing NPP Information Base
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Nowadays, verification of the initial data for designing the information base of the NPP Automated Process Control System is a guarantee of the correct operation of the NPP Automated Process Control System itself. For this verification, exact and approximate methods are usually applied. Each method provides desirable results for an appropriate problem type. Exact methods are more suitable for solving this problem. The article presents a solution algorithm in terms of checking both the structure and the content of initial data, including a complete parsing of the Kraftwerk Kennzeichen System code with the study of all its sectors. A list of the most common inconsistencies is also provided.

articleTitle: Choosing the Optimal Technology for Expanding the Adjustment Range of the CCGT-450 Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A method of unloading the 450 MW CCGT-unit by reducing the load of gas turbines and recovery heat boilers up to the level of the capacity limits of gas turbines and further reduce the load of the CCGT unit with steam turbine unloading: transfer of part of its HPC (high pressure cylinder) or HPC completely in the motor (low steam) mode (MM); using by-pass steam distribution high pressure steam through the discharge part of it into the steam line low-pressure and low-pressure cylinder. The features of hydrodynamic processes of the HPC compartments in the MM and the choice of the optimal cooling scheme for a group of stages operating in low-flow mode are given. Direct-flow and counter-flow schemes of cooling steam movement, their advantages and disadvantages, as well as the possibility of controlling the temperature state of the flow part of the HPC are considered. For bypass steam distribution, various options and ratios of high-pressure steam discharge are considered according to the specified scheme. It is shown that the considered method of unloading the CCGT allows to expand its adjustment range when the CCGT operates in both condensation and heating modes. An estimation of the energy efficiency of using this modes of CCGT unloading when passing through the gap of energy consumption schedules is given.

Author Keywords: part of cylinder of high pressure and whole HPC

articleTitle: Secure Interactions in Distributed Systems on the Basis of Cryptographic Message Syntax
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The principles of the implementation of the new network service - Protected Message Service (PMS) - intended for protected queries processing in the distributed information systems are considered. The essence of the approach consists in using Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS) standard as a basis of protected data representation in the network.

articleTitle: Mortality forecasting: Neural network approach
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Application of an artificial neural network (NN) for predicting human mortality and life expectancy has been studied. Obtained NN reflects current demographic theories, according to which mortality trends in countries with high life expectancy converge to a common trend, and the difference in the life expectancy of men and women is decreasing.

articleTitle: Logical control of a robot manipulator based on regular grammars in the presence of non-stationary obstacles in the working area
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The work is devoted to the synthesis of logical control by a robotic arm when unsteady obstacles appear in the working area. For a two-link manipulator, a grip motion control model based on a hybrid automata with a finite set of states is constructed. Using the methods of numerical simulation, the operation efficiency of the obtained logical control algorithm is illustrated.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Modeling Technologies in Ensuring Cyber Security of APCS
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper describes the development of a module for calculating security zones in the cloud service of APCS modeling. A mathematical model based on graph theory is used. This allows you to describe access relationships between objects and security policy subjects. A comparative analysis of algorithms for traversing graph vertices is performed in order to select a suitable method for allocating security zones. The implemented algorithm for calculating security zones was added to the cloud service omole.ws.

articleTitle: Features of Controlling the Large-Scale Cyber-Physical Water Supply Systems in Cities of Different Countries
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper describes control models of large-scale cyber - physical water supply systems in cities of various countries-Asia (China and Singapore), the United States, England and Europe, and Russia are analyzed. Deficiencies in control models were identified due to current potential threats of water scarcity, degradation of water sources, and risks of chemical and biological contamination.

articleTitle: Modelling the Deformation of Economic Cycles Using Methods of Non-Standard Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Structural shifts in the global economy are divided into periods. The paper identifies deformation of both Kondratiev's large business cycles and Juglar's medium-term cycles in the dynamics of Russia's GDP and in total investment as % of GDP and average annual Brent price. A modified adaptive analysis of the correlation between the oil price and the exchange rate of leading national currencies has been carried out.

articleTitle: Synchronized Phasor Measurements in Digital Substations
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the symmetric components method on the direct, return, and zero sequences for the definition of short circuit currents. We present methods and algorithms of synchronized phasor measurements and their application on digital substations.

articleTitle: The control and identification algorithm for the boost converter under unknown load
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Boost voltage converters are widely used in industry and engineering as power supplies and voltage stabilizers. The basis of the converter is a key element, with the help of which the redistribution of input energy to output energy is carried out, depending on the required transmission coefficient. The output voltage of the inverter depends on the input voltage and external load. Taking into account the switching nature of the converter, a robust relay control law has been developed in the article, which makes it possible to stabilize the output voltage at unknown load, when it is impossible to measure it.

articleTitle: Testing Hypotheses on the Street Protest Efficiency Factors: Combined Statistical Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper explores the relationship between the characteristics of a street protest and its effectiveness. We propose a new approach to solving the problem through the use of a combination of several statistical techniques: the logistic regression models with mixed effects from the Frequentist approach, the hierarchical modeling from the Bayesian approach, the propensity score matching from the Quasi-experimental approach.

articleTitle: The Theory of Economic Nonequilibrium in Application to the Regional Disparities Problems: The Impact of Coronacrisis
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This the article considers the main postulates of the theory in relation to the regional economic space. Based on statistical data, the author confirms the hypothesis that different regions of the Russian Federation are in a state of recession and inflation gaps. For recession gap price level is stable above the equilibrium, for inflation, on the contrary, the price level stable below the equilibrium.

articleTitle: The Effect of Coalition Compositions on Mortgage Lending Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The work continues researches on self-financing of the coalition of borrowers. The main stages of work are stated: problem definition, examples of possible strategy, and computing experiments. A coalition of borrowers is being considered, which in its organizational structure looks like a traditional bank. We formulate a discrete-time model, and the corresponding control problem boils down to solving a bilevel optimization problem. The choice of optimal deposit and loan rates is proposed using the parameter space investigation method. The result of a computational experiment is given.

articleTitle: Using Neural Networks To Predict Exchange Rates
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the task of using an artificial neural network to predict the exchange rate. The factors affecting the US dollar to ruble exchange rate are analyzed. Based on the results of the analysis, an option is proposed for using a neural network to predict the exchange rate.

articleTitle: Effectivenes of the Use of Scientific and Academic Information Resourses
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The methodology for assessing the effectiveness of the use of scientific and academic information resources in the Internet space has been considered in the context of transition to the digital economy and innovative development. The methodology presented has been elaborated on the basis of the analysis of state and volumes of information resources according to the results of the monitoring of websites of agricultural institutions of higher education.

Author Keywords: the methodology for the assessment of effectiveness

articleTitle: Development of a Laboratory Stand for Research of UAV Aeromechanics and Flight Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: At all stages of the life cycle of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), there is a need for experimental studies of their characteristics. In part, experimental studies of this kind could be performed on installations such as traditional wind tunnels. However, in existing wind tunnels, it is not possible to regulate the air flow speed and study the influence of the aircraft's center of mass position, as is required for evaluating the flight dynamics of modern UAVs. We present a fundamentally new concept of the laboratory stand and methodology for research of UAV aeromechanics and control problems. Results of research of aerodynamic characteristics for several UAVs are given.

articleTitle: On Problems of Continuous VaR-Criterion in Multidimensional Markets
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The work investigates the problem of using continuous VaR-criterion (CC-VaR) in multidimensional financial markets, which are markets dimensions generated by several (n > 1) underliers. Fundamental theoretical results deduced for one-dimensional markets are extended on multidimensional case. The peculiarities of multidimensional markets and their instruments are debated. As in one-dimensional case, the optimization algorithm is based on continuous applying Newman-Pearson procedure. This algorithm is derived as a result of projecting the one-dimensional algorithm onto multidimensional markets. Illustrative example of a two-dimensional theoretical market demonstrates in detail using analytical methods of constructing the optimal portfolio. The exposition is accompanied by diagrams of sequential intermediate products important for such constructing.

articleTitle: Simplest Mathematical Model of Anti-Tumor Therapy Based on Dendritic Cells
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents a simplest mathematical model of anti-tumor therapy based on dendritic cells. The model describes the stages of developing immune response to dendritic cell vaccine. The model was developed in MatLab-Simulink to conduct a computing experiment (in silico). Effective regimens of dendritic cells vaccine therapy that produce complete elimination of the tumor cells are defined.

articleTitle: Global Oil Market Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article analyzes the problems of modeling and forecasting the world oil market, and also provides an overview of approaches and models in this area. The key factors affecting the formation of oil prices are presented, and their relationship is examined. The forecasting models of the world oil market based on the use of econometric analysis methods and structural VAR models are considered. Another area is the use of game and behavioral models. Widely used models of market equilibrium analysis taking into account various market structures based on MPEC models. Of considerable practical interest are also methods that combine game models, methods of multi-agent modeling, and modeling based on expert information. The analysis presented in the work shows that in many cases the use of mathematical models to predict the global oil market is useful, it allows you to get closer to understanding the mechanisms of its functioning and the relationship of its parameters.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis in Agriculture and Methods to Manage Them
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the risks to which farms specializing in production in two sectors are exposed: crop production and animal husbandry. The ways to deal with these risks are listed. Insurance and hedging are discussed in more detail as these methods. In animal husbandry, in case of lack of feed, a method for maximizing the production based on a dynamic model of animal husbandry is proposed. The problems of information support associated with this are discussed.

articleTitle: Data Assimilation in Modern Atmospheric Quality Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper analyzes the modern estimating and forecasting air quality mathematical models for building maps of high spatial-temporal resolution. The tasks that must be solved in the future to control air pollution effects are outlined. The emphasis is on the need to assimilate heterogeneous data, including low accuracy, to improve the models' quality.

articleTitle: Laboratory Study of Different Social Groups Behavior during the Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article studies the social behavior of various age groups using experimental Economics methods. The conducted laboratory experiments show that the age of the participants and the specificity of the activity strongly influence the rate of infection spread. Simulation model with bots is constructed, the parameters of which can be adjusted to approximate the results obtained in experiments.

articleTitle: Public Administration as the Cause of Social Collapse
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of sustainable development is considered from the point of view of the possibility of achieving it using existing approaches in the world. It is argued that the organization and quality of public administration cannot provide a solution to the accumulated problems. Moreover, public administration itself becomes a source of danger to society due to the monopolization of power. Based on the growth of negative trends, the assumption is made about the possibility of social collapse provoked by illiterate or erroneous actions of the bureaucracy corrupted by a oligarchy. The conflictological approach to solving this problem is rejected as untenable. It is proposed to modernize social regulators by means of social shunting as a result of social self-organization processes.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of a Six-Legged Walking Robot Prototype
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Mathematical model of a hexapod walking robot was implemented which allow to get visual information about features of its moving in an environment and helps to develop control algorithms. Based on a computational experiment the conclusion was made that geometric method is more preferred for solving forward and inverse kinematic problems of a hexapod robot with insect legs.

articleTitle: On the Solution of Matrix Generalized Lyapunov Equations for a Class of Bilinear and Linear Dynamical Systems with Variable Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper develops a well-known method for solving generalized Lyapunov equations for continuous bilinear dynamical systems, which can also be applied to a class of non-stationary linear systems with a variable dynamics matrix and constant input and output matrices.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Modes of Application the Food Choline
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: By means of a method of mathematical modeling influence was investigated choline in a diet of rats on metabolic processes in an organism; dynamics of a nicotinic the acetylcholine expression of receptors of a brain was estimated. Selection of various schemes of application choline aimed to control reaction of an organism taking into account their purpose.

articleTitle: Performance Indicators Comparative Analysis of Stocks Investment Portfolios with Various Approaches to Their Formation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: It is presented results of a comparative analysis of the effectiveness of various approaches in forming an investment portfolio are presented on the example of portfolios consisting of shares of the leading IT and telecommunications companies for the period 2015-2020. It is presented the modified variant of the Markowitz portfolio optimization model using the indicator of stable growth of stock prices.

articleTitle: The Optimal Tree-like Networks Constructing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report deals with the exact and approximate optimal network construction algorithms with discontinuous cost functions depending on the Flow at their edges. The properties of the optimal solution of this problem are established, an algorithm for forming all trees and single-root subtrees for the graph under consideration is described.

Author Keywords: trees generation discontinuous cost function of edges

articleTitle: Features of the Decarbonization Modelling of the Russian Gas Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article describes special aspects of optimization modelling of low-carbon scenarios in the development of the gas industry in the Russian Federation, resulting from Russia's ratification of the Paris Climate Agreement in 2019. The authors review issues related to the modelling of low-carbon trends in the field of geological exploration, extraction, storage, liquefaction and transportation of pipeline and liquified natural gas.

articleTitle: Structural Dynamics, Economic Growth and Macroeconomic Policy in Russia
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to determine the conditions for a new model of economic growth in Russia. The subject is the economic structure of the Russian economy. The research methodology is structure analysis, the pair correlation method. The result of the application of these methods is the determination of the sensitivity of the contribution to the growth rate of the components of Russia's GDP to macroeconomic instruments, as well as the degree of their influence on GDP over the considered time interval. Using the pair correlation method, it was found that inflation did not significantly slow down the economic growth of Russia in the period 2001-2018, the increase in the money supply M2 stimulated growth, as well as lower portage rates. It is also shown that structural policy is an indispensable way of creating a new growth model in Russia, and reduced only to palliative measures in the form of institutional changes, creating an environment for business and the like, without changing sectoral economic proportions, it will not ensure the creation of economic growth of a new quality. One way to rectify sectoral interactions is to reduce risk in manufacturing sectors and equalize returns between the transaction, raw materials and manufacturing sectors of the Russian economy.

articleTitle: Tracking Electromechanical Systems Design with Sensorless Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: For an all-wheel drive electromechanical system, a discontinuous control law has been developed within the framework of the block approach. It provides tracking of given signals of generalized coordinates and invariance with respect to external and parametric disturbances. For the case when the sensors are located only on the drives, a dual-circuit information system is design. It includes two observers with piecewise linear corrective actions for estimating generalized coordinates and mixed variables necessary for feedback design.

articleTitle: Application of a Mistake Severity Criterion in Expert Systems Designed to Train Flight Safety Inspectors
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article was prepared within project No. 1908-00028 "Development of a concept for building the architecture of, and selecting algorithms for, an expert system aimed to improve training efficiency for flight safety inspectors" supported with a grant awarded by the Russian Foundation for Basic Research (RFBR).The article deals with an approach to selecting and substantiating parameters characterizing the competency profile of a flight safety inspector. A brand new "error severity criterion" is proposed to assess the severity of probabilities of an inspector's mistakes depending on possible circumstances and operating conditions. It offers an example of how such criterion is assessed by analyzing identified inconsistencies and violations in implementing monitoring and supervision procedures and assessing potential consequences that may result from an inspector's erroneous conclusions and findings.

articleTitle: Some Multi-сriteria Differential Game
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Some multi-criteria differential game of two players is considered. If some trajectory belongs to the inner of the intersection of the bridges, then the Slater positional guarantee exists. The guarantee is remained under a countable number of the information reception about the outcome trajectory.

articleTitle: Research of a Gas Deposit Development Model
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A continuous aggregated dynamic model of gas production at a gas field is under construction. Several issues related to gas extraction modeling are under discussion. Two possible options for developing a gas field with certain conditions are under consideration. The first strategy concerns the development of one gas field at two consecutive time stages: at a constant rate of wells drilling and in the absence of drilling. The second strategy concerns maintaining an unaltered level of gas production by commissioning new wells. We study each option in detail and draw appropriate conclusions. We also pose and solve optimization problems for maximum overall extraction and maximum profit. The issues proposed for the study belong to the class of optimal control problems with a free right end and a fixed time. The necessary mathematical apparatus is the Pontryagin maximum principle.

Author Keywords: dynamic model of a gas field
optimal control problem with a free right end and fixed time

articleTitle: Detection and Recognition Simulation of Abnormal Behavior of Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of evaluating the emergent properties of a system and detecting and recognizing the occurrence of anomalies in the behavior of a dynamic system is formulated. To solve these problems, fuzzy cognitive modeling and a set of deep neural networks are proposed. An example of recognizing an anomaly in the behavior of processes in the airfield infrastructure is being considered.

articleTitle: Concordant Mechanisms in Network with Dual Type Dependencies of Agents and Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of the correct management mechanisms (planning procedures and incentive systems). The correct mechanisms ensure reliable data communicated by agents to the Principal and the implementation of plans are Nash or dominant equilibrium strategies. Concordance conditions are obtained for mechanisms at such strategies in a network system with two types of agent dependency structure.

articleTitle: Practical Application of Neural Networks in Classification Problems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article is discussed the practical application of neural networks. The tasks solved by neural networks (forecasting, classification, clustering) are analyzed. An example of constructing an analytical neural model of economic efficiency for Rosatom is given.

articleTitle: Decision Making with Abundance of Information
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Decision-making models in the presence of uncontrolled factors are considered. It is assumed that the operating party has access to large amounts of information characterizing these uncontrolled factors. Estimates of the amount of "useful" information are obtained. Three different ways of determining the concept of "quantity of information" are considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Gas Reserves Movement Model by Category
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider a continuous aggregated deterministic dynamic model of the movement of gas reserves by category. According to the classification of combustible gas reserves, we characterize each type by the level of knowledge about the object, which is the carrier of information about the estimated stock of gas. We describe the movement of gas reserves by a system of differential equations and schematically depict this movement in the figure. When moving from one category to another, we take into account the degree of confirmation of reserves in the model. We pay special attention to the gas reserves multiplicity. To describe it, we introduce a time function that determines the total explored reserves of natural gas. We make a priori assumptions about its properties. We analyze six specific examples. For each sample, we determine the reserves multiplicity coefficient, the dynamics of which we analyze. We explain the behavior of the multiplicity coefficient and draw the appropriate conclusions.

Author Keywords: a model of the field with mutually influencing wells
a model of the gas reserves movement by category type
the function of explored gas reserves

articleTitle: Decomposition Method for Control of Twin Rotor Electromechanical System
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, a stabilization problem of angular positions is considered for the twin rotor electromechanical system under parametric uncertainties and the presence of cross-couplings between rotors. The procedure of block synthesis of nonlinear local feedbacks and discontinuous controls is developed. This procedure allows satisfying the project restrictions on the state variables and control actions. The simulation results of the developed procedure are presented.

articleTitle: Singular Controls For Increasing Oil Recovery Of Natural Oil Deposits
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
