abstract: In the process of developing oil fields, periodic disturbances are used to increase the flow rate of wells and the final oil recovery of formations by changing the mobility of oil and the filtration-capacity parameters of the porous medium. In an inhomogeneous medium, in the presence of dissipation and / or dispersion, harmonic oscillations created in the wellbores transform into sawtooth waves with periodic shock fronts, which change the dynamics of phase transitions and can lead to cavitation in liquid phases. Taking this circumstance into account will make it possible to adequately predict the dynamics of phase transitions and optimize the control of the oil production process.

Author Keywords: sawtooth waves in an inhomogeneous medium

articleTitle: Digital Economics Cyclic Development on Socio-cyber-physical Self-organization Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article aims to study digital economy business systems ontology using socio-cyber-physical self-organization technologies based on new generation wireless networks 4G, 5G, and higher. The article proposes integrating value-added chains into multiplicative and reflexive structures with positive feedback. The purpose of this strategy is to form digital self-developing macroeconomics, built on a quasi-fractal principle "developing system of developing systems".

articleTitle: On the Conservation of Laws in Complex Open Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The work develops a language environment for studying the behavior of complex systems. We consider a class of systems represented by a species of structure in the sense of N. Bourbaki. We learn morphisms of the base sets of these structures. Arbitrary morphisms can lead the system to undesirable behavior. Invariants can constraint morphisms and prevent unwanted behavior changes.

articleTitle: Econometric Methods in Solving Problems of the Analysis of Investments in the Field of Tourism on the Example of France
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we applied an econometric modeling technique as one of the investment analysis tools for predicting the value of cash flows when evaluating the effectiveness of investment in the tourism industry. We have shown, that the key role in management decisions making is identifying the factors that influence key industry variables. We proposed to use the flow of tourists and the average value of a check per tourist as the dependent variables. The results of the study were checked by French statistics.

articleTitle: Problems of Effective Operation of Low-intensity Railway Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The key factors and limitations affecting the efficiency of low-intensity railway lines are identified. Proposals have been made for their transfer to service with lightweight rail buses. Measures are proposed for servicing low-intensity lines with mobile teams, taking into account the risks of inter-functional combination of jobs.

articleTitle: Organization of Auctions in Network Models
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A network form of interaction within the association of enterprises engaged in producing a fixed set of products is considered. The interaction involves multiple local auctions through which the distribution of functions for implementation of the next production order within the association is determined. The possibilities of creating a simulation system to study the prospects of a project are considered.

articleTitle: Development of Monitoring Services for Analysis of Users’ Requests in Distributed IS
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article describes an approach to monitoring information flows in a distributed management Information System (IS). The described approach is based on the use of two methods. The first method is based on identifying subjects of documents, appeals and proposals received in the information system and devoted to issues related to the functioning of the information system. The second method is to design an analysis of the structure of the document. The developed approach allows to identify the matters of incoming documents, appeals and proposals on issues related to the quality of the functioning of the information system. The practical implementation of the described approach can significantly speed up the process of responding to user requests and improve the quality of IS monitoring and operation.

articleTitle: Identification of Informative Signs of Engine Wear Based on Experimental Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents the results of primary data processing of the experiment carried out at the Institute of Control Sciences to study the aging of the U5 KV400 electric motor, developed by the T-motor company for use in copters. As the engine deteriorates, an increase in the amplitude of the vibration and sound signals is observed and the frequencies at which this occurs are determined. In particular, it is expected that an increase in the amplitude of vibrations and sound at the magnetostriction frequency can serve as an informative sign of the increased engine wear.

articleTitle: Instruments for Assessing the Technical Condition of Human-Machine System Elements as a Basis for Maintaining its Survivability
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Methodological aspects of ensuring the survivability of the human-machine system considered as an example of one of the tasks of maintaining the active life of the spacecraft. Onboard equipment considered as a complex system consisting of functional blocks developed in various organizations using various technologies. As a tool for assessing the survivability of on-Board equipment of the proposed comprehensive criterion to evaluate the technical condition of the functional blocks defined by the probability of failure of the system software and hardware within these units, combined with the reliability of operators with on-Board equipment.

Author Keywords: assessment of the technical condition of functional blocks
probability of failure-free operation of software and hardware tools

articleTitle: Usage of Energy Produced by Angara-Yenisei Hydropower Station Cascade in Energy Systems within European Part of Russia under Possible Power Grid Restrictions
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers possibility of conducting unusable volume of energy generated by hydro power stations of Angara-Yenisei cascade during high water from years to energy system of European part of Russia and estimates possible quantity of energy and capacity conducted noting carrying capacity of inter-system power lines.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Wave Control Actions To Increase Oil Recovery Of Natural Oil Deposits
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In the process of developing oil fields, wave periodic disturbances are used to increase the flow rate of wells and increase the final oil recovery of layers. In an inhomogeneous medium, in the presence of dissipation and / or dispersion, harmonic oscillations created in the wellbores transform into sawtooth waves with periodic shock fronts. Consideration and use of this circumstance will lead to an increase in the share of recoverable reserves of fields: created by a downward vibrator: external harmonic disturbances converted in a dissipative medium into sawtooth shock waves cause cavitation in a liquid medium, and secondary shock waves generated from collapsing bubbles overcome capillary forces that hold oil residues on the surfaces of voids and cracks. These effects lead to a noticeable decrease in the permeability of the reservoir and a significant increase in the final oil recovery of oil formations.

Author Keywords: periodic oscillations in an inhomogeneous medium

articleTitle: Aspects of Time Synchronization in Distributed Control Systems in Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the Network Time Protocol (NTP) algorithm. Mathematical model of an NTP-based unified time scale maintenance system is analyzed in depth. An implementation of an auxiliary model of I&C system based on "Network Calculus" techniques is proposed. Some practical aspects of time synchronization over the NTP Protocol in virtual environments are described.

articleTitle: A control algorithm for the desired suppression level of the unmatched perturbations
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of compensating for external disturbances is one of the oldest problems in the classical theory of control. The article considers the task of stabilizing the output variable under the influence of external non-smooth disturbances, that do not belong to the control space. A discontinuous control law has been developed to provide a prescribed control accuracy for the output. Various variants of the transient process in the closed loop system are described, estimates of overshooting and steady-state error are given. The proposed approach can be widely used to compensate the bounded external disturbances, including those, that depend on the state of the system.

articleTitle: Dynamics and Exact Solutions of Third-order Nonlinear Evolutionary Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article proposes an approach to constructing exact solutions of a third-order nonlinear evolutionary differential equation based on the theory of finite-dimensional dynamics. This theory, in turn, is based on the theory of shuffling symmetries of ordinary differential equations and it is a natural extension of the theory of dynamical systems to evolutionary partial differential equations. theory of finite-dimensional dynamics makes it possible to find families of solutions of evolution equations, depending on a finite number of parameters, among all solutions of such equations.

articleTitle: The Model for Building Flexible, Multidimensional Ratings Using Linear Preferences and Utility Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: It's proposed the model for constructing of flexible ratings by end-users and it is analyzed applying of special weights for indicating of consumer preferences by various factors depends on the considered object. There is developed an algorithm for the building of flexible ratings. Practical testing was carried out by applying of investment indicators.

articleTitle: Ways to Improve the Intelligence of Algorithms for Optimal Load Distribution at CHP Plants With Complex Equipment Composition
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this work, the research team reviewed problems and presented solutions integration methods, deep learning and artificial intelligence libraries, in modern software and hardware complexes for solving problems of optimum allocation of the current heat and power production in CHP plants with complex equipment connected with the necessity of considering a large number of constraints and handling large numbers of parameters. A variant of building an intelligent system is proposed, which, in addition to a number of intelligent functions, aims to evaluate immeasurable or poorly measured parameters quantitatively, identify the current technical condition of the equipment and recommend either a solution available in the database, or conduct new calculations.

articleTitle: Conditions of Use an Extreme Regulator in the Control Loop of Large-Scale Economic Activities
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of calculating the autonomous control of a non-stationary system using only the values of the target function on a discrete set of times is considered. The algorithm of the extreme regulator is proposed for calculating the control. The conditions of its working capacity are formulated. An estimate of the exact lower margin of error of the decision, due to the size of the step in time and the rate of change of the target function, is obtained. The application of the algorithm is demonstrated in the output control model.

Author Keywords: conditions of operation of the algorithm

articleTitle: Improving Customer Relationship Management based on Intelligent Analysis of User Behavior Patterns
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A set of regression, cluster analysis, and association rule mining models, is proposed to search for patterns in user behavior regarding marketing campaigns taking into account user characteristics and financially significant metrics. Using the example of two organizations, it was possible to accurately predict the cost of customer acquisition (CPA, cost-per-action). The use of the models proposed allows organizations to improve advertisement settings to increase online advertising efficiency.

articleTitle: Structural and Topological Analysis of Homogeneous Models for a Large Robotic Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report is devoted to the problem of controlling large robotic complexes of various classes of heterogeneity. Based on the analysis of modern research in the field of robotics, the class of heterogeneity with changing control functions is highlighted. The necessity of systemic integration of control systems of a dedicated class during their operation is substantiated. The basic theoretical statements about the evaluation of the results of system integration are formulated. The problem of a homogeneous hierarchical representation of heterogeneous control systems was indicated. The solutions to this problem are suggested. A quantitative assessment of the proposed options is given. Outlined topics for further research on the problem.

articleTitle: Control in Network Model of Additive Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: An object of network nature is investigated, namely: players in the system are located in graph nodes, and the technological structure of their interactions is specified. Interest in such a class of models is determined by their practical use in neural network modeling and artificial intelligence problems and by the rationality of such a description in real economic projects. Calculation of guaranteed results of the Center for centralized and decentralized control schemes and their comparison are given.

articleTitle: A Model of Propaganda Battle with Individuals’ Opinions on Topics Saliency
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A model of propaganda battle of two parties with multidimensional information agenda is considered. It is assumed that a member of the population faces the alternative of which of the parties to support and makes their decision basing on the value of information stimuli provided by the parties. The problem of choosing a strategy by a party is considered. This problem has a form of Blotto game, which is illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Unmanned Vehicle Control System Using Microwave Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: To effectively manage the flow of unmanned vehicles in large manufacturing plants and warehouses, both in open spaces and indoors, an accurate dynamic positioning system is required. This is necessary to optimize routes in order to increase the speed of movement and prevent collisions. The article considers the application of an autonomous navigation system that uses radar motion sensors together with odometric data. The developed algorithm of adaptive data filtering based on the Kalman filter is described, which allows continuously receiving information about the current position of unmanned vehicles with the required accuracy. As a result, it is possible to optimize the trajectory of all unmanned vehicles in dynamics in order to increase the productivity and reliability of cargo transportation.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Russian Ruble Exchange Rate: Long-Term Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Developed in accordance with the author's International Flows Equilibrium Exchange Rate concept, the new model of long-term dynamics of the ruble exchange rate uses a wide range of functionally interrelated factors that determine the national currency dynamics. We use the foreign trade operations, the international capital flows with intertemporal decisions of investors, the international terms of trade as an indicator of relative competitive advantages, the index of real aggregate output as the real GDP, the indices of domestic and average actual export prices, and the consumer price index as the basic macroeconomic aggregates. Considerable attention is paid to mathematical modeling of the long-term dynamics of the ruble exchange rate in comparison with the medium-term equilibrium dynamics.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization Methods for Choosing Investment Decisions
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the project portfolio selection models of industrial companies with a complex structure of assets. We propose to use the simulation-optimization approach to solve these problems. We describe the results of the holding company portfolio selection according to the criterion of maximization of its market value.

articleTitle: Modified Sliding Mode Control for Tracking Problem of Wheeled Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The control algorithm for the mobile robot is allowing not only to solve a tracking problem at unknown parameters of system, but also to suppress influence of accompanying electromechanical systems of not coordinated disturbances. Synthesis of feedback law is carried out on the basis of block approach, vortex algorithm and sliding modes.

articleTitle: Rising Fuel and Energy Prices in the Domestic Market and Economic Growth in 2020
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to model studies of the sensitivity of the Russian economy to the growth of domestic energy prices in 2020. The results of calculations on the inter-sectoral simulation model showed that domestic prices of gasoline and electricity have the greatest impact on calculated economic dynamics. Their rapid growth in 2020 is fraught with a drop in Russia's GDP. Domestic prices of other energy sources don't have such a strong effect on GDP rates. The dynamics of real disposable incomes of the population is 30% more sensitive to the rise in energy prices than the rates of GDP.

articleTitle: Mathematical Support for Improving the Safety of High-Tech Buildings
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In order to provide safety of high-rise buildings, trade centers that are maintained by complex engineering systems of heating and water supply, electricity, ventilation, IT and so on, mathematical models and algorithms of mutually interacting systems suffering from failures or deliberate harmful action were reviewed. Special emphasis is put on a failure consequence distribution in an infrastructure and location of the objects that are most important for proper functionality of both separate engineering systems and the infrastructure as a whole. These models are tested on the example of heterogeneous engineering infrastructure of a science and research building, consisting of three engineering systems. During the simulation, the impact indicator of each node's vulnerability is calculated for each scenario. As a result of the calculations, a critical object was found for the considered engineering infrastructure.

Author Keywords: critically important elements of a network

articleTitle: Stochastic Preferences Model
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Determining the preferences of individuals is important for many scientific and practical problems, especially when modeling information control and information warfare. Previously, a model was developed that allows taking into consideration the ideological and political preferences of citizens of the Russian Federation in the three-dimensional basis derzhavnik (great power nationalist)-liberal-socialist model, as well as several methods and technologies that determine the preferences of users of the online social network VKontakte. In this paper, we propose approaches to identifying individual preferences in a stochastic preference model based on an opinion poll, which allows these preferences to be compared with the results of the analysis of an online social network.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Role of Production Analysis of Macroeconomic Factors in the Development of the Modern World Steel Market
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The results of assessing the impact of macroeconomic factors that reflect production and foreign trade activities on the world steel market in the XXI century are presented. It is established that production and market-oriented consumer operations prevail over export-import operations in the development of the market. This is promising for the global economy.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Representation of the Microfinance Process
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A representation of the microfinance process in the classical algorithmic sequence is proposed. The basic stages that affect the process itself and the goals of microfinance are highlighted. The case when it becomes necessary to solve the problems of enumeration of possibilities is highlighted. The relations of dynamics on the basis of which the legislative standards of microfinance organization activities are predicted are given.

articleTitle: Clustering in Directed Graph Using the Laplacian Matrices and Their Eigenprojections
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper is devoted to a clustering in directed graphs using the Laplacian matrices of the digraph and their eigenprojections. The relevance of the problem due to the fact that ignoring edge directionality and considering the graph as undirected is not a meaningful way to cluster directed networks. The proposed methods for clustering in digraphs based on the coefficients of the adjacency matrix of the Laplacian matrix of the digraph.

articleTitle: Infrastructure Development Management Platform in Extreme Climate
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A theoretical and methodological platform for strategic management of the development of the infrastructure of a large-scale region in extreme climatic and geographical conditions is proposed. Platform elements such as organizational systems and infrastructure development management mechanisms have been developed; methodology for determining the feasibility of developing deposits based on their business potential and costs; simulation scenario model of the development of transport infrastructure in the process of evolution of the socio-economic system of the region.

articleTitle: Evolution of Large-scale Systems in the Universal Algorithmic Space of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents an analysis of the patterns of development of the global computer environment (GCE) and its impact on the evolution of large-scale systems. The identification and elimination of the fundamental reasons limiting the further expansion of the fields of application of such systems open the way to the formation of a universal algorithmic space for the digital transformation of large-scale systems in the GCE without fundamental restrictions on their sizes.

articleTitle: Synergetic Effects in Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, some concepts of game theory are considered from the point of view of the synergetic effects of players ' participation in these games and a quantitative assessment of these synergetic effects is given on the example of cooperative games, which are a mathematical model describing various processes related to the distribution of monetary amounts between participants according to their position and the strength of participation in these processes.

articleTitle: Alternative 3D Tomography Methods and Their Applications to Identify Seismic Structure Around the Hydrothermal Gas Field
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The use of 3D tomography methods helps to the better understanding of complex structures peculiar to elements of a large-scale system, for instance, to buildings, engineering constructions, hydroelectric power plants, mines ets. Seismic tomography is important tool that the oil and gas industry applies to map the sub-surface geological structures. The LSQR algorithm by Paige and Saunders is the well-known conjugate gradient solver for the inversion tomography problem. Nevertheless, previous studies have shown that the algorithm has limitation in reconstruction of synthetic models of the large-size structure. Here two alternatives are given to resolve the complex structure: a new algorithm of the method of coordinate descent and the modification of Gaussian elimination. Both of these methods aim at constructing of the solution, which might be free from influence of determined types of error in the data. A structure with certain similar properties has been revealed for the layer from 0 to 5 km of depth by applying both methods to seismic data collected in the area around the hydrothermal gas field However, for the deeper layer the modification of Gaussian elimination produces the structure that is more realistic compared the method of coordinate descent. The reason might be in more accurate determination of the location of those seismic sources that are close to a surface. We conclude that simultaneous application of different inversion methods is useful in the presence of unclear level of errors in the data. Tomography images presented here for the area of natural concentration of gases can be applied for understanding of conditions to keep underground gases in a safe area.

articleTitle: On Accounting and Management Representation of Production and Economic Processes in Operational Game Scenario Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 13th International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the issues of describing the production and economic processes in terms of the theory of operational games using double counting (tracking the dynamics of balance and turnover on debit and credit accounts) and management accounting (tracking only the dynamics of account balances). A methodology based on scenario operational game simulation of micro-and macro-economic interactions using both approaches is proposed.
